title: Getting our long videos seen
goal: Long videos to thousands of views each.
why: All 16 long videos together were shown about 4,050 times in three and a half months.
About 2% of the people who saw one clicked it.
Viewers watched 15% to 25% of a film on average.
The Shorts feed hands every Short its viewers. A long gets no such start on a channel with 19 subscribers.

title: Starting our WW2 documentary channel
goal: Pick a channel name and lock the first WW2 films: 25-minute pilots first (~20,000 voice characters, at most 2 voiced before upgrading ElevenLabs), then 30–45 minute films twice a week toward 8,000 watch hours.
why: Name options (all 3 handles verified free on YouTube 17 Nov; @TheWarAtlas is taken): 1) Field Order History (@FieldOrderHistory, recommended) · 2) Gridline History (@GridlineHistory) · 3) Iron & Compass (@IronAndCompass).

Why this niche (vidIQ, 17 Nov): WW2 Dossier reached 1,000 subscribers in 13 days and 14,300 now on 39–56 min archive-photo films with no Shorts; 'world war 2' gets 564,442 searches/month and 'ww2 documentary' 261,896.

Voice budget: ~79,000 ElevenLabs characters remain this cycle across Orbit, History of Science and this pilot (~8,000 per 10 min). Keep pilots to ~25 min (~20,000 chars) and voice no more than 2 pilot films before upgrade or renewal.

Monetisation built in from film 1: researched script with Sources line, continuous Ben narration, sentence-matched US/UK public-domain or Crown-expired photos + code-drawn maps, ad-friendly, no deceptive AI history, no Shorts.

Studio 'Add a channel' steps (listed only, not run yet): 1) You pick the name & lock topics here; 2) Folder channels/ww2 prepared from template (done in J2989); 3) You create the Brand Account channel & GitHub repo, sign in to Studio on the Mini, and confirm voice; 4) Studio pushes channels/ww2, adds ww2 to channels/channels.json, and runs channels.py sync + channel_check.py --all; 5) Studio locks final name & publish days in studio/RULES.md before Film 001 script.

IWM Coastal Command + US Navy photos & range-ring maps; 4.13M / 1.59M / 1.30M neighbours; thumb '600-MILE DEAD ZONE'; 25 min (~20,000 voice chars, Slot 2 of 2).
